Similar verifier time for algorithms with more general kinds of quantifiers. For instance, threshold quantifiers. Currently the most verifier efficient known interactive protocol for threshold circuits is to use shallow circuits to compute threshold and run GKR. In this paper, we showed one can do better for unbounded fan-in AND and OR gates. Can this also be done for unbounded fan-in threshold gates? This would be interesting because threshold gates seem much more powerful than AND, OR, or parity gates.
